title: A feedback flag stays on its reported line number after the article is edited, so it lands on another fact
goal: feedback_flags drops or moves a flag whose article changed after the report (a fact-text hash kept with the line, or the file's change after the report's day), so a flag never shows on a fact the report did not name. Found by the SP-ficl7pxl review (ST-lcsgjg6p gap).

run: import sys;s=open("_tools/kbfacts.py").read();i=s.find("def feedback_flags");b=s[i:s.find("\ndef flag_line",i)];sys.exit(0 if ("hashlib" in b or "sha256" in b or "git_log" in b) else 1)

repro_reason: the drift needs a committed store report plus an article edit between report and read; planting both is the fix's own work, so the repro reads that feedback_flags keeps no fact-text hash or change check yet
